# `editor` — `/api/community`

Small text edits with versions, drafts kept as people type, and short-lived, cookie-free website previews.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/community/preview/{token}/{path}`](#get-api-community-preview-token-path) | Signed address | A file of a website preview at the signed address preview_token gave. |
| GET | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/draft`](#get-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-draft) | Space member | The person's draft of a text file. |
| PUT | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/draft`](#put-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-draft) | Space member | Keeps the person's unsaved edits to a text file as their draft. |
| DELETE | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/draft`](#delete-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-draft) | Space member | Throws away the person's draft of a text file. |
| PUT | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/text`](#put-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-text) | Space member | Saves a text file from the editor as a new version. |
| POST | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/previews`](#post-api-community-spaces-sid-previews) | Space member | A signed address for previewing a folder of the space as a website. |

<a id="get-api-community-preview-token-path"></a>
### `GET /api/community/preview/{token}/{path}`

A file of a website preview at the signed address preview_token gave. Needs no sign-in: the signature is the permission.

- Handler: [`preview_file`](../../../backend/community/editor.py)
- Who may call: Anyone with the signed preview address (no sign-in)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `path` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: a file, typed by its name
- `200`: a raw body, with the upstream's type

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | File not found. | `preview_file` |
| 404 | Preview expired or unavailable. Open it again. | `unpack` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="put-api-community-spaces-sid-files-fid-text"></a>
### `PUT /api/community/spaces/{sid}/files/{fid}/text`

- Handler: [`save_text`](../../../backend/community/editor.py)

| `text` | string | yes |  | at most 2097152 characters |
